d:
"A house-weary fox lets herself loose on the town one night, and finds a big beast at a club to drape herself on...

Unfortunately for someone else, the beast in question is Frank, a hellhound dedicated to indulging in what an evening can bring... regardless of what petty little rules he's breaking.

And it seems she's enjoying it just as much, isn't she~?" - Artist
